outcome: Rate of appropriate cefazolin use within 60 minutes prior to incision for cesarean section
cohort: The study included patients who underwent cesarean section surgeries at a maternity and children's hospital in Arar, Saudi Arabia over a 10-month period.
finding: The study found that over 63% of patients received cefazolin at an appropriate time, indicating a good rate of adherence to prophylactic antibiotic guidelines.
